id: Practice Direction 56 – Landlord And Tenant Claims And Miscellaneous Provisions About Land_chunk_002
content:
Document: Practice Direction 56
Part 3 of 3
==================================================
[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] 14.4 An application under section 26(3) must be made by the issue of a claim form in accordance with the Part 8 procedure and:

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (1) the claimants must serve the claim form on any person who they know or have reason to believe is a relevant landlord, giving particulars of the claim and the hearing date and informing that person of his right to be joined as a party to the claim;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (2) the landlord whom it is sought to appoint as the reversioner must be a defendant, and must file an acknowledgment of service;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (3) a person on whom notice is served under paragraph (1) must be joined as a defendant to the claim if he gives notice in writing to the court of his wish to be added as a party, and the court will notify all other parties of the addition. [This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] 14.5 If a person wishes to pay money into court under section 27(3), section 51(3) or paragraph 4 of Schedule 8 –

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (1) he must file in the office of the appropriate court an application notice containing or accompanied by evidence stating –

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (a) the reasons for the payment into court,

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (b) the interest or interests in the property to which the payment relates or where the payment into court is made under section 51(3), the flat to which it relates;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (c) details of any vesting order;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (d) the name and address of the landlord; and

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (e) so far as they are known to the tenant, the name and address of every person who is or may be interested in or entitled to the money;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (2) on the filing of the witness statement the money must be paid into court and the court will send notice of the payment to the landlord and every person whose name and address are given in the witness statement;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (3) any subsequent payment into court by the landlord must be made to the credit of the same account as the earlier payment into court;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (4) the appropriate court for the purposes of paragraph (1) is –

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (a) where a vesting order has been made, the county court that made the order; or

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] (b) where no such order has been made, the county court in whose district the property is situated. [This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > 14.3 Where an application is made under section 26(1) or (2) or section 50(1) or (2):] 14.6 If a relevant landlord acts independently under Schedule 1, paragraph 7, he is entitled to require any party to claims under the 1993 Act (as described in paragraph 7(1)(b) of Schedule 1) to supply him, on payment of the reasonable costs of copying, with copies of all documents which that party has served on the other parties to the claim. ## Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] 15.1 If a question is ordered to be transferred to a leasehold valuation tribunal for determination under paragraph 3 of Schedule 12 to the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002 the court will –

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (1) send notice of the transfer to all parties to the claim; and

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (2) send to the leasehold valuation tribunal –

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (a) the order of transfer;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (b) all documents filed in the claim relating to the question; and

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (c) copies of all orders and other entries in the records of the court relating to the question. [This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to Leasehold Valuation Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (Paragraph 15.1 applies to proceedings in Wales but does not apply to proceedings in England.)

## Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] 16.1 If a question is ordered to be transferred to the First-tier Tribunal for determination under section 176A of the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002, the court will—

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (1) send notice to all parties to the claim; and

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (2) send to the First-tier Tribunal—

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (a) the order for transfer;

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (b) all documents filed in the claim relating to the question; and

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (c) copies of all orders and other entries in the records of the court relating to the question. [This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] (Paragraph 16.1 applies to proceedings in England but does not apply to proceedings in Wales.)

[This Practice Direction supplements Part 56 > Transfer to the First-tier Tribunal under the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002] Updated: Friday, 1 October 2021
